sourceScope: Historical ES/PT wording and consent boundaries only; not current tool permissions, authentication or deployed evidence.
adaptations: Replace the former banking-read graph with Start, Process and Finish only, bound solely to a public configured model ID.
Use restored generic FLUJO Git blobs for the ordinary compiler, snapshot schema, validator and execution hash; load no banking integration code.
Accept only the agreed host-language-request/v1 data projection: schema, es/pt language, bounded user request and optional event_date, amount, currency, merchant and recorded_status display facts.
Return only host-language-guidance/v1 with schema, language and one of explain_selected, ask_date_or_amount, ask_selection, suggest_human or unavailable.
The project host validates guidance and renders deterministic localized prose; model output cannot grant authority, mutate actions or establish a ledger, receipt or human-request state.
Customer and merchant text remain untrusted data. Private identities, credentials, handles, customer selectors and bank tools do not enter the language graph.
Keep resources/prompts/customer_v0.md as the sole canonical prompt and embed its exact bytes in generated source artifacts.
Compilation and pure mutation checks are source evidence only; no installation, provider request, MCP call or customer-language acceptance is claimed.
